tools.name: get_poll_results
tools.description:
Get the current results of a DooDates date poll: votes per option, ranking and winner.
Access requires the organizer's admin link (admin_url returned by create_date_poll, the full
link containing #owner_token=) or its token; the vote link alone does not grant access.

tools.name: close_poll
tools.description:
Close a DooDates poll so it stops accepting votes, or reopen it with reopen=true.
Reversible. Closing stops new votes; it does not set a final date.
Access requires the organizer's admin link (admin_url, the full link containing #owner_token=)
or its token; the vote link alone does not grant access.
